title: Multi-sensor corroboration of UAP (satellite, radar, visual, temperature)

tellings.quote: There's like evidence from satellite, uh you know, radar, visual sightings, temperature readings, it's all totally consistent.

plain: Some UFO sightings are backed by several kinds of evidence at once, satellite data, radar, people seeing them with their own eyes and temperature readings, and "it's all totally consistent", according to the economist Tyler Cowen. He tells Michels this in 2022 as something he has heard from others, and if true it would mean these objects are not just tricks of a single camera or a single witness.
